t: Alerts & settings menu: Out of office and stand-in.
Out of office tells colleagues you are away, who covers for you, and helps you catch up when you are back.
In this video, you will learn how to turn on out of office, choose a stand-in, and catch up when you are back.
Open your profile menu and choose Out of office.
Choose when: today, tomorrow, the rest of this week, next week, or pick dates.
Choose who covers for you. People who message you see Ask them instead, and requests to your roles go to them.
Choose whether to tell people by email, and press Turn on. The preview shows what colleagues see.
Colleagues see a purple status and your note, even while you are offline. In your chat, they see a bar with your stand-in.
When you come back, press I'm back. While you were away shows your unread chats, decisions made, and action items for you.
That completes the Out of office and stand-in page.
